indicator_name: Official exchange rate, LCU per USD, period average — world economies (WDI PA.NUS.FCRF)
description: Официальный курс национальной валюты к доллару США, среднее за год — страны мира (WDI)
unit: local currency units per USD, annual average
methodology: Item = ISO3. Denominations are mixed across redenominations (no adjustment); Russia 1994-95 missing; the euro area members carry the euro rate from 1999.
